name: workflow-studio
description: Create and independently verify one substantial local artifact through a guarded visual multi-agent workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Run and visualize guarded Codex workflows
interface.longDescription: Workflow Studio is for substantial single-file deliverables that materially benefit from separate framing, planning, building, review, repair, and final verification. Invoke it explicitly with $workflow-studio or let Codex select it when that boundary is met. Simple edits, read-only analysis, multi-file implementation, command-only work, and external actions remain on their ordinary Codex paths. Every run uses fixed least-privilege controls and returns an inline dashboard with phases, findings, output, timing, and usage.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-studio for a substantial single-file brief
Show my latest Workflow Studio run
Explain when Workflow Studio is the right choice
